text:
Pranav: Quick sync — thinking about a smaller, more actionable signal taxonomy for model intake. Proposal: push lightweight perf checks to the intake gateway (before full bench), centralize telemetry tagging, and add a "escalation" label for noisy regressions. Thoughts?

Rachel: +1 on early perf but worried about flakiness from microbatch variance. Can we require N=5 warmup runs and compare median?

Mike: Agree re: warmup. Also need to watch cost — running warmups on every ingest will increase GPU ops. Maybe run full warmup only on new archive models, and cheap kernel checks for others.

Liam: For SRE the key is observability. If we centralize telemetry, use structured trace ids: `onboard.trace_id`, and standard metrics: `onboard.latency.p95`, `onboard.tokens_per_sec.mean`, `onboard.golden_pass_rate`.

bench-bot: quick note — current prober supports 3 warmups + 2 sample runs. We can add a `--baseline-runs 5` flag. PR: https://git.internal/bench/1234

Rachel: OK let's define signal tiers:
- SMOKE: run-on-ingest quick kernel & kv sanity (30s) — pass/fail
- REGRESSION: short perf run (5 inputs, N=5) — p95 and tokens/sec thresholds
- DEGRADATION: full bench (50 inputs) flagged for manual triage

Pranav: I like it. Add an "escalation" label that maps to policies:
```
if onboard.golden_pass_rate < 0.95 and onboard.latency.p95 increased > 20%:
  escalate: paging + fallback to previous model
elif onboard.latency.p95 increased > 50%:
  auto-fallback: true
```

Mike: Auto-fallback helps availability. Implementation note: on fallback route, ensure KV cache invalidation is safe.

Angela: From product: want to expose a short report in console (per-model onboarding summary) and a reason code for escalations.

Pranav: Next steps: I will draft a short RFC with signal taxonomy, metric names, and prober flags. Mike will prototype the baseline-run flag; Liam will draft the trace/metric naming; Rachel will prepare sample thresholds from historical runs. Target: RFC by EOW, prototype next week.

Rachel: :thumbsup: I'll pull historical 30-day ingest runs and propose thresholds.

Mike: Will spike on cost calc for warmups and report.

Pranav: Thanks all — marking this thread as actioned. Ping me if blockers pop up.
